title: Equilibrium Propagation for Non-Conservative Systems
summary: Equilibrium Propagation (EP) is a physics-inspired learning algorithm that uses stationary states of a dynamical system both for inference and learning. In its original formulation it is limited to conservative systems, $\textit{i.e.}$ to dynamics which derive from an energy function. Given their applications, it is important to extend EP to non-conservative systems, $\textit{i.e.}$ systems with non-reciprocal interactions.
